chapter_seo_title: Han Li Finds a Hidden Cavity in an Ancient Wall – Chapter 485 of RMJI
chapter_meta_description: While Nascent Soul elders scheme around the Cold Pearl Platform, Han Li’s Jianghu instincts uncover a hollow stone in a heavily restricted wall—something ancient and hidden.
og_title: Han Li’s Old-School Skills Strike Again
og_description: In a ruin full of divine formations, Han Li finds a secret the hard way—by tapping walls like a mortal burglar.
twitter_title: Hollow stone, hidden stash, and zero divine sense needed.
twitter_description: Han Li’s Jianghu training pays off where magic fails—he finds a secret cavity in a wall no one else thought to check.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient restriction type designed to be unbreachable except through a single, pre-set entrance; its name derives from the Big Dipper (Tiangang) and celestial arrays in Daoist ritual magic.
The central treasure-sealing structure on the fifth floor of the Void Heaven Palace; a massive stone platform encased in a white Heavenly Barrier shield.
The martial world of mortal fighters and sects; its skills (like tapping walls for hollow cavities) are considered low-brow by cultivators, but can be critically useful.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li tap the wall like a mortal burglar?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he grew up in the Jianghu, where hidden compartments are found by ear, not by divine sense; it’s an old-school, low-tech trick that high-level cultivators would never think to use.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Heavenly Barrier (天罡罩)?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s an ancient unbreakable restriction that can only be passed through a single designated entrance; in xianxia, it functions as a plot-wall to funnel characters into a specific path.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the blood-eyed winged beast carving important?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Possibly—it’s the cover for the hidden cavity. Its placement suggests deliberate misdirection; the image of a savage beast is meant to repel attention from the hollow stone behind it.
